headline: Leveraged ETFs Feeling the Heat
detail: The sharp drops in MUU, SOXL, and SPAL highlight the risks of leveraged ETFs, especially in volatile tech sectors. These instruments decay over time and amplify losses on margin, which is your current situation.
rec: Given the -25% to -45% losses and the inherent decay, consider trimming MUU and SOXL to reduce further downside risk on margin.
